articleTitle: Data Anomaly Detection Based on Isolation Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Compared with other anomaly detection methods, the traditional isolation forest algorithm improves the execution efficiency, but it still is time-consuming. Thus, an improved isolation forest algorithm was proposed to solve the problem. Specifically, we analyzed the user access data stream of the website platform through data preprocessing. Then PCA was used to reduce the feature dimension, and a parallel processing approach based on an isolation forest algorithm was used to detect the data. The detection efficiency of the proposed method is verified through the standard simulation data set.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Campus Culture Application Based on AR and Metaverse Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Under the background of closed campus management of Chinese universities, the combination of Metaverse technology and campus exhibition is advantageous. Through Metaverse technology, the overall campus scene is constructed by reverse modeling of unmanned aerial vehicles through three-dimensional point cloud scanning, which integrates campus spirit and cultural elements. Then, the campus culture APP is designed and developed. The campus culture APP based on the metaverse innovates a new idea of virtual integration and interaction on campus and has a positive impact on improving the campus culture environment, enriching the manifestations of campus culture, and expanding the construction of campus culture.

articleTitle: Big Data Technology Based Ecological Characteristics and Teaching Mode for the Teaching of College Public English
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Nowadays, the new English-teaching model for the application of big-data-technology(BDT) has received wide attention. This model combines online learning and classroom face-to-face teaching to improve the efficiency of classroom teaching significantly. However, the application of big-data-technology(BDT) based English teaching not only brings opportunities for modern English teaching but also imposes challenges. One of the practical challenges is that the intervention of the application of big-data-technology (BDT) affects the traditional College public English education ecology. Therefore, It is obliged to redefine the ecological characteristics of the teaching of college public English under the application of big-data-technology (BDT) and explore the corresponding teaching model. In this context, firstly, we analyzed the ecological characteristics of the teaching of college public English and then constructed the Teaching model of College public English-(TMCPE) under BDT. The research finding contributes to expanding the database of English teaching and contributes to building a comprehensive, balanced and reasonable environment, or the College public English education.

articleTitle: The Development of Early Warning System for College English Academic Performance Based by Big Data Computation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the rise and development of big data technology, data mining has been applied to various education fields. Particularly, the use of data mining to predict students' academic performance has been explored by educators to optimize teaching decisions. By contrast, there still lacks a set of cohesive frameworks on how to use this big data technology in college English teaching, and how to incorporate data mining into a warning system needs to be further elucidated. In this context, we first analyzed the necessity of early warning for the college English academic performance, and then expatiated the development paths and implementation frameworks based on big data. We studied the technical framework of early warning for the college English academic performance to help teachers find problems and improve English teaching effects.

articleTitle: Design of Motor Speed Control System Based on STM32 Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the application of embedded technology in servo motor control, the motor speed regulation method has gradually changed from analog to digital ones. Especially, DC motor control with ARM has become a new trend. We design a PID speed regulation system based on an STM32 microcontroller. The system includes an STM32F103C8T6 minimum system, power module, motor drive module, key module, MX1508 double H bridge, speed measurement module, TFT display module, and others. The design adopts the principle of pulse modulation for DC motor speed regulation based on STM32 internal PWM signal, output to MX1508 double H bridge motor drive module for driving amplification, and then drive signal output to DC motor. The duty ratio of the PWM signal is adjusted to achieve the motor steering and speed control. The system has a simple structure, strong anti-interference ability, and high cost-performance. MATLAB simulation results show that the speed regulation of PID DC motor based on the STM32 microcontroller is better than the traditional control strategy and has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Construction of College English Education Mode Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, artificial intelligence is no longer limited to the integration with classroom teaching, but is gradually integrated into Teachers’ scientific research, campus management, student evaluation, and even campus life. In this context, we analyze the current situation of college English education and discuss how artificial intelligence enables college English education. Finally, a new college English education model is constructed based on artificial intelligence. By analyzing the current situation of college English education and combining the advantages of artificial intelligence, we put forward the countermeasures of using artificial intelligence in college English education to provide a reference for educators.

articleTitle: Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the systematization, complexity, and intelligence attributes of modern machinery, a large number of rolling bearings are used in various mechanical equipment. As the core component of the mechanical equipment, the health state of the rolling bearing is of vital importance as its failure can affect the normal operation of the equipment and threaten the safety of people's lives and property. At the same time, with various current testing equipment used in machine operation and maintenance, a large amount of data has been collected and used to predict the health status of the bearings. In this context, we analyzed the rolling bearing fault mechanism and its diagnosis techniques, then proposed the method to do the rolling bearing fault diagnosis by using deep learning. The bearing fault diagnosis model is proposed based on deep learning. The model contributes to the sustainable use of rolling bearings and machinery accident prevention.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Smart Canteen Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The Internet and schools have become more closely related. Since more middle school students choose to eat in canteens, it is important to provide appropriate nutrition. The cafeteria problems occur in two areas. Although meals are diverse, they are not proper for the physical condition of students. Foods are easily wasted, too. To address these two problems, we design and develop a machine learning-based cafeteria dining system. The system solves the nutrition problem for secondary school students and the cost control problem of canteens through neural networks and decision trees.

articleTitle: Visual Analysis of Forest Carbon Sequestration on Entropy Weight Method by Big Data Computation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: According to the forest growth law and practical application significance, a comprehensive evaluation model of forest overall value is established by considering that biological value is divided into ecological value and economic value. Entropy weight method was used to determine the weight of each index of original forest, reclaimed forest and plantation forest. The visual analysis of forest carbon sequestration big data was carried out to determine the scope of management plan. As a suitable rotation cycle depends on whether there is a transition point from deforestation to forest management plans, it is of theoretical and practical significance to reduce carbon dioxide emissions, improve energy efficiency and build a green, low-carbon and circular development economic system.

articleTitle: English Website Localization Competence Evaluation of Chinese Enterprises Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The localization of English websites of Chinese enterprises makes them accessible, usable, and culturally suitable to their target audiences. It helps Chinese enterprises see the growth in websites traffic, increase orders, and grasp more markets worldwide. How an English website serves as a communication window to the target audience always concerns many Chinese enterprises. However, factors that influence websites’ localization competence are varied and complex as they are a non-linear mathematical problem for the evaluation of websites localization for avoiding randomness and subjectivity. Thus, by combining the literature review of the competence evaluation, the expert consultations, and the websites localization process, we establish an evaluation system for Chinese enterprises’ English website localization. Three-layer BP neural network, a type of nonlinear uncertain mathematical model is used to solve the non-linear mathematical problem for the evaluation. Test results show that the BP neural network model is precise and practical in evaluating websites localization competence.

articleTitle: Research on Video Object Tracking Based on Improved Camshift Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Target tracking is one of the important research directions of computer vision, widely used in intelligent surveillance, pedestrian detection, military war, and other fields. In this paper, the Camshift algorithm is improved based on multi-feature fusion. Aiming at the problem that the color of the tracking target is similar to that of the background, the Local Binary Pattern feature is partly improved and adaptively fused with the template generated by the joint chromaticity and saturation components. As it is easy to lose the target in the case of occlusion, the improved algorithm incorporates the Kalman filter. According to the statistics of the experimental results, the improved algorithm achieves a better tracking effect.

articleTitle: Neural Network Radionuclide Identification Algorithm Based on Exponential Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The development of nuclear energy and the application of nuclear technology is inseparable from the detection of radionuclides. Considering the incomplete utilization of γ-spectral information in traditional spectral analysis methods, the accuracy is not high. In this study, exponential smoothing is performed on the energy spectrum signal of length 1024 to eliminate the influence of the statistical fluctuation of the detector, and then it is used as the input of the neural network to realize the full spectrum analysis. The method avoids the complex feature extraction process and can identify a single radionuclide in real time.

articleTitle: Case Study on Application of Artificial Intelligence to Oral English Teaching in Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The intelligent education represented by artificial intelligence technology provides a breakthrough and a new revolution in English teaching as it carries out accurate teaching, constructs intelligent learning network space and solves the dilemma of "spending more time but achieving little effect". With the increasing demand for students in higher vocational colleges to speak English, the FIF oral English platform is tested to carry out an experimental study. Based on a comparative analysis of experimental and controlled classes, the effectiveness of AI is studied in promoting English listening and speaking teaching to boost the deep integration of AI and English teaching in higher vocational Colleges.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Push-up Magnetic Levitation Device with Wireless Power Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: We present a redesigned push-up magnetic levitation device for expanding magnetic levitation device’s application and improving its performance. In the magnetic base, a H-bridge analog circuit, instead of L298N chip, is built as the module of driving the suspension. Also, a suspension detection module with an AH49E linear Hall sensor and a transmitting coil driving circuit of the radio energy transmission module are integrated into the circuit. Quantitative analysis of the relationship between the permanent magnet weight and the suspension height shows that wireless conduction is achieved when ensuring continuous and stable suspension (suspension height is within 15mm from the sensor) and adding a LED light module. In this optimized design, the suspension detection module functions normally, and spatial utilization of the device is improved while power consumption is reduced. This design provides understanding and possibilities to achieve various functional requirements in specific application scenarios.

articleTitle: Soil Nitrogen Detection Based on Random Forest Algorithm and Near Infrared Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: In order to achieve rapid detection of soil nitrogen content, a method of soil nitrogen content detection by near-infrared spectroscopy combined with a random forest regression algorithm (RF) was proposed. The spectral data and nitrogen contents of 143 soil samples were collected to establish the detection model by combining the random forest algorithm. The results show that the preferential selection of RF modeling data by ∆Gini can extract the spectral information related to soil nitrogen content and reduce the redundant information of the data. The prediction accuracy of the established RF model is high with a correlation coefficient of 0.909 and root mean square error of 0.1412 for the test set prediction. This study proves the feasibility of NIR spectroscopy combined with a random forest algorithm for soil nitrogen content prediction. The result also demonstrated the feasibility of combining NIR spectroscopy with a random forest algorithm to predict soil nitrogen content and the theoretical basis for the subsequent development of soil composition testing instruments.

articleTitle: Development of College English Personalized Learning Support System Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the popularity of big data, artificial intelligence, and distance education, the teaching and learning of college English have changed significantly. In particular, personalized college English learning based on data mining technology has emerged as a key topic at this stage. In this context, we first analyzed the overall scheme of the college English personalized learning support system and then expatiated the core implementation methods of the college English personalized learning support system. The modeling methods and the generation countermeasures of the college English personalized learning scheme are included. The idea of personalized education is integrated into college English with big data to establish the main position of students in learning, improve the effectiveness and pertinacity of education, and maintain the dynamic balance between students' personalized development and social development.

articleTitle: Online and Offline Experiential Teaching Reform Mode of Piano in Normal Colleges on Account of Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Educational reform is ongoing, and the importance of music courses is becoming more important in education. We aim to find a way to improve the innovation of the online and offline experiential teaching reform model of the piano, by using genetic algorithms. After many tests and verifications, the improved online and offline experiential teaching reform model of gaoshi piano has an obvious improvement effect on improving the teaching quality. The use of genetic algorithms enhances the online and offline experience of gaoshi piano courses with the basic content and related theories. The data test analysis proves that the teaching reform model based on the improved genetic algorithm promotes the efficient improvement of teaching quality of the piano.

Author Keywords: online and offline experiential teaching reform

articleTitle: Research on Mini French Corpus Construction Based on Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: To meet the needs of French learners for language training, the mini-language corpus construction and its language evaluation are put forward, introducing noise reduction technology and an extraction feature module. Keywords, statistical main word frequency information, the corresponding paragraph, and the construction principle are marked to learn with the technology. The method needs to collect a representative French corpus and regularly update it. By using new software analysis data, the experiment found that the corpus through a computer program has different combinations, which meets the application needs of students. A comprehensive assessment of French vocabulary greatly improves the application efficiency of the corpus. The result confirms the design ideas proposed by the mini French corpus and effectively helps the students master and use French vocabulary.

articleTitle: Interactive Feeding Machine for Fur Baby
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Modern people are busy with work or schoolwork, and often go out on business or long-distance travel, resulting in the problems that their beloved pets have not been fed and taken care of for a long time. Therefore, there is a demand for pet products such as pet feeding machines, treadmills, and trackers in the pet market. Current pet feeding machines provide simple functions such as regular and quantitative feeding, one-way video, and communication between owners and pets, but there lacks interaction between owners and pets and real-time pet health monitoring.Thus, we propose a pet feeding machine with functions of interactive and pet cat health monitoring, two-way video and communication, pre-recording and video recording, and infrared thermal sensing. Owners can use mobile phones to connect to pet feeding machines to have two-way video and communication with cats. Fur babies can see owners through feeder screens, to make them feel that they are cared for at any time. The pre-recording function plays owners’ pre-recorded voices and recorded videos to attract fur babies to come and eat and make them feel that owners are around. Infrared thermal sensing helps monitor the fur baby’s body temperature at a close distance when the fur baby eats from the pet feeding machine and determines the fur baby’s health status. The above functions make owners go out and take care of fur babies at any time as if at home through the devices.

articleTitle: Hole Opening Number of Black Fungus Bags and Optimal Design of Cutters by Artificial Intelligent
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Black fungi are one of the four great edible fungi in the world. They are crispy, tender, and tasty, and rich in nutrients including protein, calcium, iron, rough fiber, vitamin, carbohydrate, and mineral elements. We study the influences of hole number of fungus bags on the formation of fungus buds, the modes of location-induced fungus production to the quality and quantity of fungus slices, the structure of hole cutter, and working parameters to the reliability and output of fungus bags. Artificial intelligence optimization is carried out as an opening tool. Through a single factor regression analysis, the optimal hole number of fungus bag is found to be 140. The maximum output of fungus bags and the best economic benefit are produced by V-shaped holes with an angle of 90-120°.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Analysis of Vibration Isolation Rail Transfer Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the industry, enterprises have high requirements for the stability and efficiency of rail transport vehicles. In this study, a vibration-isolated rail transfer vehicle is designed, and the key technical parameters are determined. Based on SIMPACK, a multi-body dynamics model of the rail transfer vehicle is established. The optimization results of suspension parameters are simulated and verified, and the simulation results show that the optimization results can minimize the energy of vertical vibration of the car body, and the rail transfer car has lateral stability. Taking derailment coefficient, load reduction rate, acceleration, and wheel-rail force as evaluation indicators, the influences of different loading conditions and operating conditions on the curve passing performance of the conveying vehicle were investigated respectively. The relevant research results provide a reference for the engineering application of conveyor vehicles and the design and application of similar products.

articleTitle: The Construction and Application of AI Tax Risk Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence not only changes thinking mode and technological innovation but also brings great opportunities for the development of tax supervision. Based on big data, we explore how to construct an efficient AI tax risk evaluation system and apply the system in the process of taxation supervision. We propose a big data integration platform based on hierarchy architecture to classify the underlying heterogeneous data sources according to themes and use the data warehouse as the middle-tier data source. According to this platform, we construct the AI tax risk model and predict the tax risk of the target enterprise. The results show that the system plays an effective role in tax supervision and the prediction is accurate compared with the traditional supervision method.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Mining Evaluation System of Beijing Opera Art Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Considering the important position of Peking opera art performance in Chinese traditional culture, it is necessary to comprehensively and accurately understand and monitor the quality of Peking opera art performance. In order to achieve this, we build a comprehensive and representative evaluation system of Beijing opera art performance. Taking the satisfaction index of Peking opera artistic performance as an important indicator of perfection, a Peking opera artistic performance evaluation system is established with 4 dimensions and 10 indicators. By using factor analysis, the evaluation index model of Peking opera artistic performance is validated.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Algorithm of RDMA Network Congestion Control for Data Center
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: RDMA transmission protocol has the characteristics of high bandwidth and low latency. However, through the test and research of several mainstream RDMA network congestion control strategies in different network scenarios, it is found that these strategies have poor performance when dealing with large-scale Incast traffic. This affects the stability of the RDMA network in the data center. Thus, we propose an improved algorithm QQCN based on the congestion queue at the receiver. The QQCN algorithm maintains a congestion queue at each receiver and feedbacks the congestion status of the receiver to the sender. The sender dynamically adjusts the rate according to this feedback signal. Therefore, the QQCN algorithm improve the overall bandwidth utilization and stability of the network.

articleTitle: Design of Glass Handling Robot end Effector and Its Trajectory Planning Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The substrate glass has the characteristics of large size, thin thickness, and easy breakage. The quality of the substrate glass handling robot directly affects the yield and production efficiency of flat panel display products. According to the characteristics of the substrate glass, the optimal design criteria of the robot end effector are proposed with a design of the optimal time and minimum impact multi-objective trajectory optimization scheme. By establishing a kinematic model, we analyze the forward kinematics and inverse kinematics of the robot and the singular configuration of the robot. Based on the multi-objective genetic algorithm, the Bspline curve is used to construct the robot trajectory, and its optimization model is established. MATLAB Robotics Tool carries out the motion simulation and trajectory planning example simulation of the MCL130 robot. The simulation shows that the motion time and joint impact of the robot have reached the optimum.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Saving and Emission Reduction Technology of Automobile Engine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the increasing number of cars all over the world, environmental pollution is becoming more serious. Environmental problems are becoming more important, and the requirements for automobile energy saving and emission reduction are becoming higher. Energy saving and emission reduction and improving the energy utilization rate of the engine have become the new requirements for modern cars in this era. Thus, we aim to solve the problem of reducing pollution emissions in the process of automobile operation with the consideration of compression ratio technology (VCR), variable cylinder technology (VCM), fuel stratified injection (FSI) which are currently widely used technologies. These technologies can improve fuel economy to a certain extent, reduce exhaust emissions, and effectively reduce the environmental pollution caused by automobile exhaust.

articleTitle: Analysis of Structural Parameters of Engine Crankshaft Oil Seal Based on Finite Element Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: For the engine crankshaft oil seal as the research object, we established a model with finite element analysis. The model allowed studying the influence of structural parameters such as oil seal lip angle, interference, R value, spring stiffness, and waist thickness on the static sealing performance. An effective way has been found for the optimal design of the structural parameters of the crankshaft oil seal.

articleTitle: Modal Optimized Similation Analysis of Wheel Brake
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The braking noise generated by the car seriously affects the riding environment in the car. The disc brake has been widely used due to its mature technology, simple structure, stable performance, and long service life. However, the brake disc and brake pad have modal coupling with similar modes of other components, resulting in braking noise. The finite element theory is used to investigate the modal characteristics of each structural component of the brake. The influence of the change of the geometric parameters of the brake pad on the instability of the brake is studied, and the structure of the brake is optimized.

articleTitle: Research on Gesture Recognition with Multi-channel EMG Sensor and Nine-axis Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: As a painless, non-invasive, and convenient electromyography (EMG) detection method, surface electromyography (sEMG) signal has great potential for applications in gesture recognition, intelligent control, and other fields. However, the traditional measurement method only uses the analysis results of the single measurement index of the EMG sensor, which is not efficient in practical application and analysis. Based on the original EMG data, we combined the angular velocity and acceleration of the nine-axis sensor for comprehensive analysis. By extracting the time-domain and time-frequency domain characteristics of the signal, we optimized the support vector by using the particle swarm algorithm. The machine performs action recognition. The experimental results show that the average recognition rate reaches 95%. This lays the foundation for using EMG signals to control other devices in the future.

articleTitle: Construction of Ideological and Political Virtual Museum Based on VR Unity3D from the Perspective of Digital Humanities
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: In the digital age, the integration of new changes and directions of the media and the development of ideological and political teachings in colleges and universities has brought opportunities and challenges for teachers and students to study and think deeply about theories. Based on Virtual Reality (VR) technology, the virtual museum is developed by using Unity3D as the main development tool, C # programming language, and Virtual Reality toolkit. It has interactive functions such as exhibition viewing, text introduction, and video appreciation. It is an effective medium to promote the reform, innovation, and development of the teachings of the ideological and political theory course. It also leverages the strength of Chinese profound history and culture and explains profound theories in simple language. Therefore, the construction of the ideological and political virtual museum is one of the important ways to promote the innovation of ideological and political courses in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Research on Circulation Data Model of Paper Books in University Libraries Based on Big Data Computation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: We analyze the four years’ book circulation data of 2016-grade undergraduates of Beijing Institute of Fashion Technology to understand the reading tendency of undergraduate students and build a library book circulation data model based on big data computation. In the follow-up development of the library, upgrading and development of big data technology and the utilization rate of book resources make the library become a smart knowledge service organization. On this basis, suggestions for strengthening the construction of book collections and the work of readers are put forward.

articleTitle: Study on Influence of Suspended Particulate Matter in Water Body Online γ Energy Spectrum Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the expansion of the nuclear energy scale and the wide application of non-power nuclear technology in China, the online γ energy spectrum measurement of inland storage water bodies has become an important monitoring technology to ensure public radiation safety. However, the change in the water body environment seriously affects the accuracy of online γ energy spectrum measurement results in the water body. In this study, the suspended particles in water are studied through Monte Carlo simulation and physical experiments, and the effects of non-radioactive suspended particles and radioactive suspended particles on the corresponding detection efficiency of radionuclides are analyzed. The results show that the non-radioactive suspended particles have little effect on the detection efficiency of the water body online γ energy spectrum measurement system in a certain turbidity range (under normal environment), and there is no need for turbidity correction. For radioactive suspended particles, the interference of radioactive suspended particles on the measurement results of 40K, 238U, and 226Ra gradually increases with the increase of water body turbidity. At the same time, a correction method for the influence of water body turbidity of radioactive suspended particulate matter is proposed based on the linear relationship between turbidity and nuclide content in suspended particulate matter. Using the turbidity activity concentration correction to treat 40K nuclides, the relative error of the correction value is less than 1.6%, which realizes the correction of the influence of water turbidity, and further improves the online accuracy of the water body online γ energy spectrum measurement system.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation of Computer Virus Propagation Model Based on Netlogo
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Based on the infectious, destructive, and latent characteristics of computer viruses, we constructed a B-SEIR model with the SEIR model and Netlogo platform. The simulation results show that increasing the probability of transformation from latent state to complete immune state β and from infected state to complete immune state γ effectively reduces the risk of virus infection in the network. Decreasing the probability of new nodes joining the network μ and the probability of computer crash caused by virus infection in the network δ also effectively reduces the number of infected computers. At the same time, reasonable suggestions are put forward for the experimental results.

articleTitle: GMC-based AI Digital Monitoring System and Mutation Theory Application on Men's 20km Race Tactics in Jakarta Asian Games
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: We analyzed the segmental results and the average speed change trend of each segment by using methods such as literature data and mathematical statistics. The data of the top six athletes participating in the 20km men’s walking race was collected from the Jakarta Asian Games GMC system. The results show that the level of physical fitness affects the performance of the game, and the segment time and speed of the game determine the tactics. Primary indexes such as athletes' competitive ability, segment time, environmental factors, and penalty affect the performance. The overall speed distribution of Chinese athlete Wang Kaihua and Japanese athlete Toshikazu Yamanishi was the same. They slowed first and then sped up. The other four athletes were all fast first and then slowed. The first six athletes started at a slow speed and then accelerate gradually. The remaining athletes used a "fast first and slow later" speed distribution method. The lower the athletes, the earlier the highest speed appeared. The players in this competition used follow-up tactics based on their strengths. In addition to the tactical use of the first two athletes, the tactical use of the last four athletes was not reasonable. Wang Kaihua and Toshikazu Yamanishi had relatively good acceleration ability in the first half and speed-maintaining ability in the second half. The other four athletes had different degrees of speed reduction in the second half. Chinese athletes Wang Kaihua and Jin Xiangqian won gold and bronze medals. Wang Kaihua adopted a speed-shifting tactic. Silver medalist Toshikazu Yamanishi adopted a follow-up tactic.

articleTitle: Research on Solar Term Poetry Evaluation AI System Using Improved Decision Tree Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The decision tree algorithm is one of the commonly used data classification methods and a relatively mature information mining technology. The logic of its work process is clear, the work efficiency is high, and the data classification has high accuracy. The research data of the evaluation system obtained by the decision tree is easy to understand and implement and has the advantages of high feasibility, high precision, and strong logic. By selecting 30 solar term poems, we used 20 of them as training samples to establish a comprehensive evaluation index model for solar term poems and determine the weights. A solar term poetry evaluation system is also constructed by using an improved decision tree network. The other 10 are used as testing samples. The results show that the horizontal comparison of multiple samples has an accuracy of higher than 80%, and the vertical comparison of a single sample has an accuracy of higher than 88.89%. It is proved that the model can be used as a solar term poetry evaluation system with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Financial Crisis Based on Case Reasoning Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The case reasoning artificial intelligence technology (CRAIT) is introduced into the intelligent warn-supporting system for constructing the quantitative warn-supporting system of enterprise financial crisis in the external and internal environment of the enterprise according to expert knowledge and experience. By combining these two, comprehensive warn-supporting is enabled. In the whole progress of CRAIT, the speed and quality of case retrieval are improved.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Legal Education under the Background of Big Data Computation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The purpose of legal education is to cultivate professional legal talents, let them master the framework of the current legal system, use legal reasoning, and solve practical problems according to legal logic. In the context of big data (BD), artificial intelligence (AI) technology helps collect a large amount of information and process the information centrally, making the calculation process much simpler. Therefore, we apply AI to the education industry, design a law teaching system based on AI, and conduct a teaching effect test experiment. The experiment shows that the average grade of the class using the artificial intelligence system for law teaching is higher than that of the class using the traditional teaching method, and the grades increase faster, verifying the feasibility of the artificial intelligence teaching system in legal education.

articleTitle: Development and Prediction of Software Design from Perspective of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The era of big data integration and cloud service information processing requires large amounts of data in software design and operation. Based on the perspective of big data, we collect the relevant data of software design by using big data acquisition technology. Multiple regression linear equations are used to construct the software design prediction data model from four aspects, namely, applicable object population of software, the repair of software bugs, the download of new users, and user experience. The correlation coefficient between the prediction model and the actual data is 0.72228, which verifies the prediction model. Through the analysis and full consideration of the changeable factors in software design, the development of software design with standardization is proposed.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of UAV Air Defense Decision-making Ability Based on Fuzzy Multi-attribute Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: An air defense threat assessment model is proposed based on the three variables of mission execution capability, air defense threat intensity, and threat reduction, and the analysis model of the variable influencing factors of air defense threat is given. In order to evaluate the ability of the UAV to reduce air defense threat, an evaluation model of air defense decision-making ability based on a multi-attribute factor fuzzy algorithm is proposed. On the basis of determining the membership degree of single factor evaluation and selecting the fuzzy relation operator, the method and process of selecting the weight of each decision factor are designed, and the reference factors for evaluating the air defense capability of the UAV are proposed. Through the construction of the air defense model and the simulation analysis of the air defense capability, it is concluded that the evaluation model of the air defense decision-making capability improves the survivability and the mission success rate of the UAV.

articleTitle: Quantitative Research and Analysis on Perceptual Imagery of Mongolian Furniture Structure Using SPSS Software
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: We propose a design research method to quantitatively analyze the perceptual imagery of Mongolian furniture structures from the perspective of perceptual engineering. By using SPSS software to perform cluster analysis and factor analysis on the experimental data, a perceptual imagery space is constructed between users and Mongolian furniture structure samples, and the perceptual-semantic correspondence is analyzed between structure samples and public factors to explore the visual perceptual imagery of different Mongolian. The result is used to assist the differentiation of Mongolian furniture products and provide a scientific and rational reference basis for the selection of structure design in Mongolian furniture design.

articleTitle: Application of Natural Radiation Measurement in Environmental Assessment of Jinzhou Binhai New Area by Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: According to the on-site measurement of surface natural radionuclides <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</sup>K, <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">232</sup>Th, and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">238</sup>U, the influences and causes of geological conditions and surface media on radioactivity level in Jinzhou Binhai new area areas were analyzed. The influence of natural radioactivity level and its distribution were summarized by massive measured data, too. The results reveal that the average radioactive of nuclides <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</sup>K, <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">232</sup>Th, and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">238</sup>U in the region was 810.83 Bq/kg (range value 87.80−2284.90 Bq/kg), 38.58 Bq/kg (range value 3.65−129.11 Bq/kg), and 26.05 Bq/kg (Range value 1.24−58.05 Bq/kg). The concentration of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">238</sup>U and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">232</sup>Th nuclides were slightly lower than the national and world average, and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</sup>K concentration was significantly higher than the average. The external exposure index was between 0.14−1.03, far less than the national limit of the external exposure index of building materials. The external exposure index of the measuring point D0107 exceeded 1, reaching 1.03. The annual effective dose rate varied from 0.03 to 0.19 mSv/a, and the average value was 0.08 mSv./a, which was much lower than the 1.0mSv limit for the annual public dose of public exposure recommended by the International Committee for the Prevention of Radiological Protection (ICRP) Recommendation No. 82. Through environmental assessment through big data, the result showed that the distribution of radiation levels in Jinzhou Binhai was relatively stable in the non-polluting situation.

articleTitle: Design Framework of Smart Pension Platform Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the aggravation of the aging problem of China's population and the promotion of the "smart city", the smart pension characterized by intelligence and information technology has developed rapidly in recent years. Smart pension refers to the use of advanced information technology means to carry out connected, interconnected, and intelligent elderly care services for the elderly. The core advantage of the smart pension lies in the use of modern information technology to conveniently combine the elderly with the government, hospitals, communities, and other social resources. In this context, based on knowledge and practical experience, this study is carried out to put forward the design framework of the smart pension platform. We first analyzed the functional requirements of the smart pension platform based on big data, and then presented the system design framework of the big data pension platform, including physical architecture framework, dynamic capacity expansion design framework, database design framework, and big data platform design framework. The research results provide basic technical solutions for the development and maintenance of a smart pension platform based on big data and help to integrate the current scientific and technological resources and improve the lives of the elderly in their later years.

articleTitle: Classification Technology of Network Multimedia Communication Based on Deep Learning Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With 5G and the Internet of things, the access of massive devices and the emergence of low-power service signals have become inevitable. In order to adapt to different business scenarios, more business signals emerge, and the identification of signal business types has become an interesting research topic. Nowadays, most of the research on signal recognition and classification focuses on the recognition of the modulation mode of wireless signals. However, this has the disadvantages of complex calculation, and cannot identify all signals uniformly. Therefore, we propose a method of automatic extraction, recognition, and classification of the power spectrum waveform of the wireless signal by constructing a convolution neural network model. After more than 500 training, the recognition accuracy of the neural network model reaches higher than 99%.

articleTitle: Construction of Cylindrical Vector Wave Function and Its Application in Cylindrical Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: By using the dyadic Green's function method, the electromagnetic field engineering problem is solved to construct the dyadic Green's function. The function is obviously different for different coordinate systems and even difficult to describe. Based on the scalar wave function with discrete eigenvalues in the cylindrical coordinate system, the vector wave function in this system and its orthonormal property are studied, and the first type of electric dyadic Green's function in the cylindrical waveguide is deduced in detail. The function provides a theoretical basis and method guidance for the DGF method to deal with boundary value problems of electromagnetic fields such as cylindrical waveguides.

articleTitle: Study on Automated Detection Technologies for Dimensions and Coating Status of Propellants
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The geometry, size, and coating status are important for the quality of propellants. The existing measurement of the geometry types and sizes of current military propellants is based on MIL-STD-286C w/CHANGE 2 which is proposed by the US military. Manual cutting and inspecting do not guarantee the accuracy and timeliness of measurements. Thus, the method is not used in real-time measurement of propellant manufacturing due to its incapability. It only is used to improve the quality of propellant production after manufacturing. With the rapid development of machine vision and automation, traditional manual inspection is replaced by automated optical inspection (AOI). In this study, based on the sizes of propellants, two AOI detection systems were developed to analyze the size and coating status of propellants. A precision cutting and polishing of propellant grains and powders were carried out through a dedicated polishing tray and positioning aids. Measurements of inner and outer diameters of perforations of propellant particles and proportional analyses of coating statuses of deterrent in coating layers were conducted by image recognition technology. The result was stored in a stand-alone database. This AOI detection machine analyzes 32 small and 3 large particles within 15 min, respectively, which is a significant improvement in analysis speed and accuracy for propellants. The new method improves the manufacturing process of propellants.

articleTitle: Hesitant Fuzzy Preference Based GMCR-AHP Model for Conflict Solution in Work Resumption of Large-scale Engineering Projects Affected by Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Schedule control is a key part of project management. The delayed schedule leads to a conflict of interest for the stakeholders involved in the project management process. The degrees of conflict resolution usually reflect the level of project management. We propose a graph model for conflict resolution (GMCR) for the improvement of interest conflicts among stakeholders including developers, contractors, and governments in engineering projects affected by the COVID-19 pandemic—projects suspended due to the epidemic gradually resumed work and production with the recovery of the epidemic. The developer asks the contractor to speed up the process to complete the project within the agreed time limit. However, the contractor has a heavy financial burden during the epidemic. Speeding up the process means more expenses, resulting in bargaining and further conflict. The model uses hesitant fuzzy preferences to express the preference information of DMs composed of multiple individuals, develops an analytic hierarchy process (AHP) that considers the potential contribution of stakeholders to prioritize relative preferences, and finally uses hesitant fuzzy preference relations to extended stability analysis and obtains equilibrium decisions, which verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Construction Engineering Quality Management System Based on Big Data and BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technologies such as big data, cloud computing, the Internet of Things, and 5G in recent years, the construction industry, as the traditional industry, urgently requests the transformation of its project management from extensive and low-efficiency mode to high-quality development mode. Under the background of the gradual development of newly-emerged technologies and concepts such as BIM technology, smart construction, and digital twin and based on the full investigation of the quality management requirements of construction enterprises, closed-loop management is focused on the whole process of construction engineering. From the perspective of construction engineering quality management, current theoretical tools such as the Internet of Things, big data, and BIM technology are combined. Taking Python as a basis, the mature and open-source WEB framework, database, and front-end and back-end technologies are used to design and construct a set of construction engineering quality management systems. We explore the digital potential of construction engineering quality management systems to provide a new way of thinking for the informatization, systematization, and system process-oriented development of construction engineering quality management.

articleTitle: The Application of Authentication of Audio Recordings Technology in the Public Security System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Criminals are using big data technology to commit audio recording crimes. Thus, the authentication of audio recordings is proposed for public security. As the digital audio recording is characterized by convenient editing, hidden traces, and rapid technological change, it has become an urgent problem to solve for public security. In this study, the common speech processing methods are tested using document properties, auditory analysis, and sound spectrum analysis. The technology of the authentication of audio recordings provides a basis for investigating and solving cases and become another tool for public security organs to fight crime.

articleTitle: A Simulation Test Software System of CET-4 Based on J2EE
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the internationalization of China, English, the international common language, has become a compulsory course for colleges and universities. Generally, universities are required to reach CET-4. Teachers usually produce final papers, and the question types are not consistent with those of CET-4. Therefore, the final examination is less helpful for students to pass CET-4. In order to help college students and English teachers better simulate training, we developed software for reforming the system with the latest test questions of CET-4, namely listening, writing, word selection, blank filling, reading comprehension, matching reading comprehension, careful reading, and translation. The technology used in the system is JavaEE + struts.

articleTitle: Novel Interpretation Teaching and its Implementation Paths Under Informatization and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the development of virtual reality, artificial intelligence, and big data, various modes of English teaching have been explored to improve teaching efficiency and efficacy. To date, the college English teaching based on such information technologies has gradually shifted to the level of a "smart classroom" with information technologies. However, the integration of the information technologies in English interpretation teaching and their organic reconciliation remain to be further discussed. In this context, we analyzed the current situation of English interpretation teaching and its demands for information technology to articulate the reconciliation paths of informatization and big data. The research results contribute to clarifying the boundary and combination framework between information technologies and English interpretation teaching.

articleTitle: Chinese Text Sentiment Classification Model Based on FastText and Multi-scale Deep Pyramid Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of Chinese text sentiment classification, a text sentiment classification model based on FastText and multi-scale DPCNN are proposed. First, a text vector matrix is constructed using the FastText model. Then, multiple feature maps are extracted from the text vector matrix with a multi-scale filter. Finally, multiple feature maps are fused and input into the DPCNN model for sentiment classification. Experiments are carried out on the Chinese sentiment mining corpus (ChnSentiCorp) dataset, and the comparison results of multiple groups of experiments show that the proposed model can effectively improve the accuracy of text sentiment classification compared with other algorithms.

articleTitle: Data Mining Technology Based Targeted Funding AI System for the Poor College Students
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the expansion of higher education in China and the resultant increasing number of college students, the number of students from poor areas and poor families has also increased. To enable students with financial difficulties to successfully complete their studies, China has been improving the financial aid system. However, the current financial aid for the students is mostly based on individual application and subjective determination, which is often unsatisfactory to achieve targeted funding. Thus, we analyzed the advantages of big data in targeted funding and then designed an index system for the accurate identification of college funding needs. The construction principles of index system design was included in the basic process of data mining, logistic regression model, data flow map design, and the classification method. We proposed the basic framework of targeted funding with data mining technology for poor college students, which is conducive to the development and realization of related systems.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Tactics of Men's 50 km Walking Race in the Asian Games Based on Mutation Theory by Big Data Computation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Based on the scientificity, availability, objective authenticity, and representativeness of data, a walking race is an endurance project with technology. The level of physical fitness affects the performance, and the speed of the game determines the race result. Athletes' competitive ability, segment time, environmental factor and penalty stop time affect their performances, too. The performance of eight athletes participating in the men's 50 km walking race was analyzed to understand how a tactic influenced the race result. In the race, a high temperature and humidity caused great difficulty and made the physical consumption of the athletes serious. The segmented times of the top five athletes were fast first and then slowed down significantly. The average segmented time of each athlete was slower than at starting. The fastest speed appeared at 35 km, while the most athlete's speed improved in the second half. The lowest speed was observed at the last 15 km. The speed at the start was too high as the athletes hoped to have the competitive ability. The catastrophe series method, mathematical statistics, comparative analysis, and literature method were used for the analysis. The level of physical fitness seems to affect the performance of the athletes, and the segment time and speed determined the tactics of the race.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation of Ant Colony Foraging Behavior Based on Netlogo
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Ant colonies are not blind in their search for food and move based on various information left behind by others. Therefore, by using the Netlogo simulation platform, we simulate the behavior of ants and introduce pheromone and environmental factors to influence the movement trajectory of ants and find the optimal route by increasing the number of ants. By increasing the number of effective ants, the overall search speed of the ant colony is improved and the search area is expanded. At the same time, in the traditional ant colony algorithm to solve the path planning problem, by introducing a different number of influence factors, a reasonable model is built to solve the optimal path planning problem. Finally, the optimization algorithm is verified by a simulation experiment, and the feasibility of the optimization is proved.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional and Accurate Instructional Design of Pedagogy Major Network Courses Based on Random Semantic Understanding Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Arbitrary semantic understanding technology is widely researched in the application of intelligent technologies such as educational big data and cloud computing. Many researchers use data mining, machine learning, deep learning, and other technologies to predict grades. In the post-epidemic era, the ability of arbitrary semantic understanding effectively improves the existing framework of online teaching and students' search and learning effects. Thus, we tested and evaluated several major courses in education to provide the content for future online teaching and improve the overall platform level.

articleTitle: Detection of Transient Overvoltage and Analysis of Insulation State of Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the increase of transmission voltage level and long-distance transmission lines, transient overvoltages threaten the insulation safety of power system substation equipment. Aiming at the problem of transient overvoltage, system substation equipment and the importance of establishing transient overvoltage response monitoring are proposed. The equipment is combined with the comprehensive analysis and calculation of the relationship between the insulation coordination of electrical equipment and the insulation state of the equipment by using a predictive analysis method for the insulation safety of power Through transient overvoltage test, online analysis of the insulation working condition of substation equipment, locking the time zone and fault point where insulation accidents may occur is possible, and the insulation safety status of substation equipment can be predicted. It is beneficial to put forward the basis for preventive protection and predictive maintenance of substation equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Assessment Model of P2P Lending Network Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: We construct a risk assessment matrix for P2P lending platforms to qualitatively analyze the platform risks. By combining the mainstream natural language processing technologies (TF-IDF model, LDA topic model, Word2Vec shallow neural network word vector model), we analyze the platform “User reviews” text data to extract keywords. After standardizing them, new features for qualitative analysis of platform risks are analyzed. The risk assessment is carried out for the platform to predict the risk value of the lending platform.

articleTitle: Finite Element Simulation Research on Structural Improvement of Forklift Fork Frame
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: Forklifts are widely used in production and manufacturing sites. As the main working part of the forklift, its structural strength directly affects the service life and safety performance. Three optimization schemes for the fork frame are designed, and the finite element method simulation software is used to compare and analyze the stress distribution and deformation of the fork frame. Finally, an improvement scheme for adding buffer devices and local reinforcement is found to improve the effectiveness of the forklift. The practical application of forklifts provides a reference and has important practical significance.

articleTitle: Recognition of Illegal Websites Based on Similarity of Sensitive Features of Mixed Elements
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: In order to identify illegal websites efficiently, a recognition method based on feature similarity of multiple web page mixed elements is proposed. This method constructs the website feature vector based on the web page text content, access path, and website association platform attribute. The method calculates the similarity between the website to be judged and the historical website in the case base. Then, the average similarity of top k cases is selected as the basis for judging the possibility of illegal websites. The experiment shows that the judgment based on similarity can achieve better results in the context of fewer historical cases and better case data quality. Therefore, the method is suitable for scenes where it is difficult to obtain typical illegal website cases.

articleTitle: Research on Construction and Application of Chinese-English Parallel Corpus Based on AI Decision Tree from Perspective of Community with Shared Future for Mankind
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The concept of community with a shared future for mankind is important for the diplomatic thought of socialism. Meanwhile, the existing Chinese-English materials provide the necessary information for the development of a Chinese-English corpus. We discuss the background, significance, and process of the development of the Chinese-English parallel corpus to construct it based on the AI decision tree and use the corpus for language teaching and research.

Author Keywords: community with a shared future for mankind

articleTitle: Design of Lamp Servo Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: It is necessary to improve the traditional single auto lighting system function as there is no automatic control function. Thus, the control needs human intervention with a poor view and dangers at night. Therefore, by using a single chip microcomputer as a controller, we designed a lamp servo control system to realize automatic and sensitive light perception with the steering wheel rotation function. The hardware circuit and system software were designed and implemented with the direction detection module, the main control system module, the light drive circuit module, the power supply circuit module, the steering gear drive circuit module, and the light detection module. The system has a simple structure and convenient operation.

articleTitle: Development of Detection Equipment with AC and DC Sources for Increasing Inspection Safety of Industrial Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The substation of the power system supplies electricity to industrial plants as the primary source. The high-voltage electrical equipment is essential to maintain the stable operation of the substation. Therefore, the periodic inspection of high-voltage electrical equipment is essential in small factories as well as in large industrial plants. The high-voltage transformer, as one of the equipment, is required in the substation with power cables, bus bars, and high-voltage isolation switches and circuit breakers as related peripherals. At present, the inspection circuit is connected directly and simply to the high-voltage circuit breaker, which is dangerous for inspecting engineers. To remove the risk of the inspection of high-voltage circuit breakers, we developed an "AC/DC auxiliary detection module" to improve safety and convenience. The output voltage switching function is added according to the different voltage requirements for AC and DC controls. Through the detection module, the inspector monitors AC or DC voltage output according to the voltage demand of the high-voltage circuit breaker. When the voltage is overloaded in the input terminal, a protection mechanism initiates to prevent the fault of the equipment and ensure the safety of the inspectors. The inspection device cut the power off to protect the equipment under high current or continuous abnormal output voltage. Accidental touch of the output terminal of the auxiliary detection module in the equipment shell and other parts automatically cut the power off, too. The developed module provides the safety for the subsequent inspections of high-voltage circuit breakers.

articleTitle: Design and Practice of Campus Network Based on IPv6 Convergence Access in Guangdong Ocean University
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: For the smart campus of Guangdong Ocean University, we analyze the current situation of the university's network construction, as well as the problems in infrastructure, equipment, operation management, and network security. We focus on the construction objectives and design scheme of the smart campus, including the design of network structure and basic network services. The followings are considered in this study: optimization of network structure simplification, business integration, multi-operator access environment, operation and maintenance guarantee system, organic integration of production, and teaching and research after network leveling transformation.

articleTitle: Study on Relationship between Online Learning Behaviors and Learning Effects Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the development of online education, learning behavior analysis is important to evaluate the effect of online learning and provide feedback for teachers and students. Thus, we explored the relationship between online learning behaviors and learning effects from the perspective of blended learning. Research subjects include 62 college students who take the course, College English 3. The data is collected from the platform of the Chinese University MOOC. Data mining and statistical methods are used to analyze students’ online behaviors. The correlation between online behaviors and learning effects is analyzed to reveal the impact of online behaviors on learning effects. The results show that assignments, unit tests, and SPOC exams have a significant positive correlation with learning effects. There is no significant correlation between the number of posting and commenting with learning effects. The duration of video watching is negatively correlated with learning effects. Based on the results, it is proposed that the assessment of online courses is adjusted and platform functions need to be optimized in order to promote effective learning behaviors.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation of New Energy Vehicles Based on Life Cycle and Efficiency Assessments
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: At present, the world is facing the problems of an energy shortage, excessive carbon emission, and air pollution, which requires new topics for the development of the automobile industry. A new energy vehicle is an important measure to solve the above problems. Thus, we discuss the background of the emergence of new energy vehicles, and the significance and inevitability of developing new energy vehicles. The vehicle’s energy consumption, emission, and its economy based on life cycle are analyzed in detail by comparison method and the feasibility of the new energy vehicle market is analyzed. The effective methods are proposed for the life cycle management of new energy vehicles based on efficiency assessments.

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Data Analysis and Data Processing Method Based on Network Traffic
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: We studied an anomaly detection method based on a network traffic model starting with the intrusion detection of abnormal network traffic. The impact of data preprocessing on the detection model was analyzed by discussing the processing of original data. An anomaly detection method on the machine learning algorithm is proposed, which combines information gain and principal component analysis for the high-dimensional problem of data features. The experimental simulation data shows that the feature dimensionality reduction method improves the accuracy of the intrusion detection model compared with the traditional single feature dimensionality reduction method.

articleTitle: Using Delphi-Fuzzy to Construct a Multi-attribute Decision-making Model for Interior Decoration Projects
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The interior design company has a professional design team, Engineering management ability, contractors of various types of work, and new technology building materials information. Interior design companies are a technical industry that specializes in creating high-quality living indoor environments. The research is using two sets of the Delphi Method and Fuzzy logic theory to construct a multi-attribute decision-making model for interior decoration projects.

articleTitle: Big Data Based Design Framework for Comprehensive Evaluation System of College Students
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: The development of cloud computing, the Internet of Things, mobile Internet, and other associated technologies are related to big data. Based on the big data technology, the design framework for college students' comprehensive evaluation system is developed to provide flexible, holistic, and easy-of-use intelligent services for teachers and students. The design of college students' comprehensive evaluation system using big data is one of the core contents of smart campus construction. However, the current evaluation system for college students has not incorporated big data, which needs to be further improved. In this context, we analyzed the background and advantages of big data in the evaluation system for college students and then presented the architecture of the evaluation system including data storage layer design, implementation process design, and data demand design. The evaluation model provides a theoretical basis for the development of a smart campus.

articleTitle: Bidding Price Forecast of Construction Projects Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: In this study, we focus on the need for the parameters of the Support Vector Machine (SVM) which is optimized by the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm. SVM has higher recognition advantages in solving nonlinear problems for small samples and high dimension pattern problems. By choosing the Gauss longitudinal kernel function as the kernel function of the nonlinear decision function, the nonlinear problem is converted to a linear problem by using SVM. A detailed presentation of the required kernel function is defined. Under the premise of guaranteeing the parameter optimization of SVM, PSO algorithm for the optimal speed improves the computing speed of SVM. Through Matlab2014b, the results show that the bidding price prediction strategies based on the PSO-SVM algorithm have significant feasibility.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study of VR and AR Technologies on the Revitalization of Intangible Cultural Heritage: Taking Putian Wood Carving Techniques as an Example
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: In the 21st century, the Chinese government has promoted the inheritance and innovation of intangible cultural heritage, and Putian woodcarving has also flourished with the support of local policies. For nearly a thousand years, Putian woodcarving techniques have been inherited in one continuous line as they have constantly innovated and been ingenious in modeling. They are vivid in patterns with numerous praises. In modern times, the handicraft of woodcarving artistically enters people’s lives, tends to be aesthetic, and is relatively successful in commercialization. However, its relatively high-end positioning and static display of unity make it hard for the modern public, especially the young poorly to appreciate, which results in a relatively rigid phenomenon. Therefore, how to effectively use digital interactive art to reflect the charm of wood carving and gain more recognition and affinity is worth exploring. This research is carried out to mainly discuss the status quo and dilemma of Putian wood carving and how digital interactive video art can be added to Putian wood carving as the intangible cultural heritage inheritance and innovation.

articleTitle: Application of Mobile Information Technology in Chinese International Education: A Case Study of Chinese Learning APP
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: With the initiative of China General Secretary Xi Jinping, Chinese international education has met new opportunities and challenges. With the development of mobile information technology in the new era, Chinese learning has become more convenient. Based on the theories of mobile learning and self-regulated learning, we investigated the use of Chinese learning APP by overseas students in China for 157 foreign students from universities in China as the subjects of investigation. Through the analysis of the data, it is concluded that the Chinese learning APP is conducive to the reform and innovation of Chinese international education because of its characteristics of informality, mobility, fragmentation, autonomy, and individualization. The app also meets the different needs of overseas students in China.

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis of Applying Artificial Intelligence to Criminal Justice and Their Prevention
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computation, Big-Data and Engineering (ICCBE)
abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence and big data technology have developed rapidly, affecting many fields of human life, and criminal justice is no exception. We first briefly discuss three main foundations of applying artificial intelligence to criminal justice to propose three major risks that artificial intelligence may face when applied to criminal justice. Then, we analyze the reasons for the risks mainly through big data analysis, supplemented by empirical analysis and other methods to conclude that the risks are unavoidable. Finally, according to the development characteristics of artificial intelligence and the status quo of local government, we propose how to prevent these risks by defining the status of artificial intelligence, accelerating the introduction of artificial intelligence, adding the option of intelligent trial, and establishing and improving the accountability mechanism for wrongful cases.

Author Keywords: construction of the rule of law
